sources.snippet: 99M-parameter open-weight TTS running locally on CPU. 31 languages. No GPU, no cloud, no API.

sources.title: GitHub - supertone-inc/supertonic: Lightning-Fast, On-Device ...
sources.snippet: Supertonic is a lightning-fast, on-device multilingual text-to-speech system designed for local inference with minimal overhead. Powered by ONNX Runtime, it runs entirely on your device—no cloud, no API calls, no privacy concerns.

sources.title: README.md · Reza2kn/supertonic-3-litert at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The GELU fuse is the key unlock for INT4 LiteRT. Without it, onnx2tf emits FlexErf ops which disqualify the model from ai_edge_litert (the runtime that supports INT4).
